title: Reject duplicate SCHC mapping entries to preserve canonical residues
description: Post-fix review found mapping descriptors accept duplicate values. Compression emits the first index while decompression accepts alternate indices for the same semantic value, creating noncanonical/malleable encodings and interop ambiguity. Require unique mapping entries for MatchMapping/MappingSent and test duplicate maps at widths 1 and 128 plus alternate-index rejection.
notes: Independent correctness review also requires at least two unique mapping entries; singleton currently consumes a gratuitous index bit and Python rejects it.
